otherWay.text: Capital spending was 4.8 times stock pay. The shortfall is mostly investment, not stock pay.
The company paid $166 million to buy back shares and $369 million in dividends over the period.

summary: From fiscal 2016 to 2025, FULLER H B CO reported $30.7 billion of revenue and $1.7 billion of free cash flow. Stock pay was $199 million, which leaves $1.5 billion of owner cash: 4.8% of revenue.
Owner cash was under 3.0% of revenue in 3 of 10 years.
In the 12 months to 2026-08-29 it was 2.1% of revenue.
